Declared-branch-if-a-pin-is-owed: claude/issue-9909-machine-locale-census

Claimed at 2026-09-19T12:14Z, dev dispatched in the same act.

⚠️ **A half-state this seat opened and is closing here.** The label write (`pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`
+ assignee) landed a few minutes ahead of this comment, and in that gap the card read as H2 —
assignee set, no `Claim:`. ⛔ Not a pattern to repeat: labels first is the protocol, but the comment
belongs in the same act, not the next one.

### ⭐ 取卡前置 — North Star clause 3, re-taken for THIS claim

| product repo <sub>open-issue enumeration, PRs excluded · 取数时刻 2026-09-19T12:09:18Z</sub> | open P0 | open P1 |
|:--|--:|--:|
| objectstack-ai/objectstack | **4** | **43** |
| objectstack-ai/objectui | **0** | **6** |

⇒ gate **CLOSED**. ⛔ No p2/p3 工具卡 or 契约卫生卡 may be dispatched.

⭐ **This card is neither, and the reason is not a technicality.** It is a population read of a
**user-visible product defect** — a date or a number rendered in the machine locale where a person
reads it. Its acceptance条件 carries its own escalation rule: 「if **any** site the table judges to BE
this defect sits on a published, user-visible path ⇒ the card becomes **p1**」. ⇒ this is the
instrument that decides whether a P1 is hiding in this class, ⛔ not a tool card competing with the
P1s the gate is protecting. ⚠️ And the escalation is **reported, ⛔ never acted on**: grading belongs
to the triage seat, which is vacant (objectstack#6015).

### The premise, and why it is not re-derived at source by this seat

⚠️ Every address, package name and count in the card body — 「~13 packages」 included — is the
**card's own list of candidates**, and the card says so. ⛔ This seat did **not** re-take them and the
dispatch says so in its first paragraph: the dev re-takes all of it and reports its own 取数时刻.
⇒ ⛔ no reading in this comment asserts a site.

The one thing this seat did verify, on the card itself at 取数时刻 2026-09-19T12:13:13Z: the
card is `open`, carries `priority:p2` + `domain:ui`, and has exactly **one** comment — the triage
定级 at `5732677680`. ⇒ no ruling, no objection and no prior claim sits between triage and this act.

### ⛔⛔ The deliverable is a TABLE, not a repair — the dispatch's first binding paragraph

This class has been closed **six times on six file surfaces** (objectui#4541, #4553, #4566, #4576,
#9453, #9786) **and reappeared every time**, because each repair was scoped to whatever card was in
flight. ⇒ carding the thirteenth package is doing the seventh. ⛔ The dev is instructed not to repair,
not to open a repair PR, and to **stop** if the table finishes early.

Three acceptance conditions carried in verbatim: (1) site → **this defect** / **deliberate fallback**
/ **not applicable**, ⛔ never a total; (2) every 「deliberate fallback」 row states **why**; (3) ⭐ the
**lit control** — `packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx`'s `catch` fallback to
`toLocaleDateString()` — appears in the table judged **⛔ not this defect**. ⚠️ Repairing that one
would BE the defect, so it is fenced out by name.

### Branch policy for this card, stated so the board can read it later

⭐ **No pin owed ⇒ no branch, no commit, no PR** — the census returns in the dev's report and this
seat's verdict carries it onto the card. A branch appears only if the dev judges an **instrument**
pin is owed (the masked scan and/or objectui#9786's runtime tripwire), and then only as a **draft**
PR that says in its first line that it adds an instrument and repairs nothing. ⛔ Landing is this
seat's act, never the dev's.

### Declared file surface

**Read-only** across whatever packages the dev's own re-taken scan names. The only writes permitted
are the report itself and, conditionally, one instrument pin plus a `.changeset/` entry.
⛔ OUT by name: `packages/plugin-detail` (objectui#9786's, already repaired, its gate question
unruled), `packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx` (the lit control), `packages/plugin-chatbot`
(in flight, below), and `pnpm-lock.yaml` (H17 trigger on this board: objectui#8348, objectui#9868).

### 在飞相交检查 — batch now 2/3

This seat's other live card is objectui#8426 (PR objectui#10017, `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useObjectChat.ts`),
read at 取数时刻 2026-09-19T12:13:13Z as `open` · `mergeable_state: clean` · in the merge queue.
⇒ two ways this card cannot collide with it: the census is **read-only**, and `packages/plugin-chatbot`
is fenced out of the dispatch by name. ⛔ No shared write surface with any other in-flight card on
this board.

### Three instrument lessons the predecessor card paid for, carried into the dispatch

① ⛔ a raw grep counts **prose** as code — the originating card's 「11 sites」 was 9 code + 2 lines of
one file's doc comment ⇒ the dev must use the repo's declared `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` and ⛔ not
re-roll one. ② ⛔ a source scan **cannot see the whole class** — objectui#9786's tenth site was an
optional prop no caller ever supplied, reachable only by that card's **runtime tripwire**; the dev
says whether it was reused or why not. ③ ⚠️ this card's original control is already **DARK** (PR
objectui#9777 landed and extinguished it) ⇒ the dev picks a control a repair cannot extinguish, and
says which.

## The per-site adjudication table

Re-taken **2026-09-19T12:15Z** on `origin/main` **5eabe8646**, comment-masked with the repo's declared `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`. Sites are cited by their **expression**; line numbers are as-of this commit and are the subject of the census, not a cross-file address.

⭐ **The lit control is row 1.**

### Verdict: DELIBERATE FALLBACK — not this defect (2)

| # | Site | Expression | Why it is a deliberate fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 ⭐ | `packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx` (`formatAbsoluteDate`) | `catch { return date.toLocaleDateString(); }` | **THE LIT CONTROL — ⛔ NOT this defect, and repairing it would BE the defect.** The try leg already passes the session `language`. The catch fires only on the `RangeError` `CanonicalizeLocaleList` raises for a structurally malformed tag (`en_US`, `''`, `zh CN`); a well-formed but unknown tag such as `xx-YY` does not throw. Letting that `RangeError` reach the outer catch would print the raw `2026-08-01T09:30:00.000Z` — worse than the un-localized date it replaced. The no-argument call restores exactly the previous behaviour, so the worst case of following the session language is the status quo, never a regression. ⛔ Not touched. |
| 2 | `packages/core/src/utils/number-display.ts` (`formatDisplayNumber`) | `return new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, intlOptions).format(value);` | Same shape as the control, one package over. The primary leg is `new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, intlOptions)`; this is its catch, retrying without the tag and keeping every other option, so a malformed tag arriving from a tenant config (ADR-0053 `localization.locale`) never takes a grid cell down while a genuinely bad `currency` still reaches the caller's own catch. |

### Verdict: NOT APPLICABLE (4)

| # | Site | Expression | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | `packages/fields/src/currency.ts` (`currencyFractionDigits`) | `new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { style: 'currency', currency }).resolvedOptions()` | Formats no face at all — an ICU **metadata probe** for the ISO-4217 fraction-digit count. The file states and measured that the digit count is locale-independent while the symbol is not, which is exactly why its sibling symbol helper keys its cache on the (locale, currency) pair and this one deliberately drops the locale. Nothing rendered, nothing to localize. |
| 4 | `packages/components/src/ui/calendar.tsx` | `data-day={day.date.toLocaleDateString()}` | A `data-*` **attribute value**, not a rendered face; no end user reads it. Also a No-Touch upstream Shadcn file (AGENTS.md commandment #7) — editing its logic is banned and the sync script would overwrite any repair. (The attribute being locale-derived at all is noted separately as a stability smell.) |
| 5–6 | `apps/console/src/sdui-tiers-preview.tsx` ×2 | `{'$' + r.amount.toLocaleString()}` and `Total: {'$' + total.toLocaleString()}` | Both live inside the `reactSource` template literal — **demo page metadata in a dev-preview harness**, on synthetic amounts. `apps/console`'s vite config declares no `rollupOptions.input`, so only `index.html` is built and `sdui-tiers-preview.html` is a dev-server-only entry.
